title: Open From Data Center to Desktop: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models
hook_text: Nvidia just dropped a massive AI update.
hook_before: Nvidia just released the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL model.
script:
Nvidia Nemotron just beat previous efficiency records for agents.
This 120-billion-parameter model handles specialized always-on agents faster than anything before.
They also debuted the Bolt 74B-A9B model for local workloads.
It delivers 24 gigabytes of optimized power for your desktop.
For even smaller setups, the new Bolt E4B model runs on just 4 gigabytes.
These models shift the burden from massive data centers directly to your hardware.
Would you prefer your AI running locally or in the cloud?

editor.one_line: Strong technical content undermined by repetitive, static, and uninspired visual presentation.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Change to 'Nvidia just set a new efficiency record for AI agents with Nemotron 3.5.'
LINE 6: Change to 'These models shift processing from massive data centers to local hardware.'
visual_notes: line 1: The same globe graphic is held for too long, causing visual stagnation.
line 2: The Nvidia logo is static and lacks dynamic motion or relevant context.
line 3: Repetitive use of the same logo icon makes the reel feel like a slideshow.
line 4: Visuals are too minimalist; needs a representation of a desktop or local hardware.
line 5: Visuals are identical to previous frames, failing to differentiate the E4B model.
line 6: Abstract text-only graphic fails to illustrate the concept of 'shifting' workloads.
